title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Kiwi Passionfruit Guava 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Kiwi Passionfruit Guava blends three tropical fruits into a colourful, multi-layered fruit vape. The sweet and tangy taste of Kiwi provides a vibrant foundation, while the tart, aromatic notes of Passionfruit add a delicious complexity. Finally, the lush, mellow flavour of Guava rounds out the mix, delivering a supremely well-balanced and exotic taste experience. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Kiwi Passionfruit Guava is designed to replicate the bold, layered flavours found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures lasting depth of flavour while maintaining a smooth and satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid delivers an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a favourite among vapers.
